_doc: Swift settings the p10 stability program requests for Package.swift targets (plans/cmux-next/stability-DESIGN.md, section C.5).
Implementers add rows here and never edit a manifest by hand; the settings lander (p10-stability-198,
scripts/cmux-next/apply-stability-settings.py) appends each row's setting to the named target's swiftSettings
in one commit, skips a setting the target already has, and compile-checks the result on the fleet.
Row: package (folder of the Package.swift, repository-relative), target (literal target name), setting (one
SwiftSetting expression, exactly as it goes into the manifest), task (the p10 task that requested it), why.
